gaps: Wind gusts at nearest station (4km) reached 44mph, below the 55mph threshold stated; rainfall at 27mm/hr exceeded the 25mm/hr threshold. Named storm Chandra corroborates severe weather but does not itself establish the threshold at this specific postcode. The discretionary clause permits other factors to be considered but no siting or exposure factors are documented in the file.

evidence.quote: Ponding water pooled on the decking (dated); the kitchen flat roof shows established ponding
Internal ceiling staining below the leak; The internal staining is directly below the failed section
heavy rainfall at a rate of at least 25mm per hour

Sagging, soft decking board (dated); Bitumen patch repair over an earlier split (dated); Moss growth along the upstand (dated); the covering had reached the end of its serviceable life and was already failing
Field inspection carried out and photographed on 29 Jan 2026, the day after the reported loss
Decking failure was not consistent with a one-off event; it was gradual.

gaps: No dated pre-loss photographs exist, but the adjuster's dated photographs the day after the event show established ponding, sagging decking, a prior bitumen patch repair and moss growth - all indicating a long-standing condition. The rainfall may have triggered the final leak but the roof was already failing.

review.draftParagraph: Rainfall on 28 January 2026 exceeded the policy threshold at 27mm/hr, but the photographs taken the next day show the flat roof was already failing: established ponding, sagging decking, a prior bitumen patch repair and moss growth all point to gradual deterioration. The storm revealed rather than caused the leak. Your £680 emergency tarpaulin cost will be reviewed separately as a temporary repair to prevent further damage.
